text: Irena Gallier comes to New Orleans to reunite with her brother Paul, raised in psych wards, as a black panther [mauls a woman in a fleabag motel|images|animals and birds]. Drawn to the captured cat, she takes a job at the zoo and [falls for its curator Oliver|who_suffers|spouses and lovers], while fearing what physical intimacy may bring. Paul reveals their [werecat heritage, born of sibling parents|origin|family blood and inheritance]: [mating with a human turns them into panthers|rules|the body changes], and only killing a human restores their form.
